title: Ing Outcast ibat keng Garden
intro: Ing metung a misteryosung lelangan misan menuknangan ya keng pekamatas a ranggu ning pamaglalang, mas malapit keng Divine kesa keng aintindian da reng dakal. Pero ing pamagmaragul mika yamut ya, at ing metung mung gawa ning pamaglaban binayu ne ing dalagan ning pamibye-bye. Ngeni, ining taung ini maglakbe ya bilang metung a kalaban a sinumpa, magbulong at magplanu angga king datang ing aldo a mipangaku. Malyari meng abalu ing pangatau na niting mebagsak?
clues: Metung ku kareng pekamalapit keng banal a presensya, mitas ya babo ning dakal a lelangan.
Melalang ku ibat king metung a sangkap a mapaling, e ibat king gabun o gabun.
Inyang inutus da kung yugse king arap ning bayung lelangan, e ku bisa — uling king paniwalan kung sarili kung panga-matas.
tinabi da ku at sinumpa, pero keng katataulian midinan kung reprieve angga keng metung a balu, at mitakdang oras.
sinumpa ku na paligayan ku la reng dakal a agyu ku, lalapit ku kareng lahi nang Adan ibat kareng sablang direksyun.
Aku ing makabuklat, mipabalu a kalaban ning mabilug a tau, parating magplanu at magbulong angga king mitakdang kawakasan.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
